Rooms.Name: A small rocky island
Rooms.Description:
The waves break over this rocky outcrop, which pokes angrily out of 
the sea. Dark spikes of volcanic rock stab at the sky, and deep vents 
spew foul smelling vapours into the air. In the middle of the tiny 
island is a volcanic vent, larger than the others, perhaps even large 
enough to walk into.

Mobs.Name: tornado
Mobs.LongDescription: THE tornado is here, and crushes you!

Mobs.Name: squid giant
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant squid is here entangling you with hundreds of tentacles!
Mobs.Description:
It has hundreds of tentacles that end in cruel suckers and vicius barbs. As
you look at it you see that it has no other thoughts than just to kill you 
an eat you raw.

Mobs.Name: moby dick whale
Mobs.LongDescription: Moby Dick, the famous white whale bubbles around here.
Mobs.ActionScript: %15 emote blows a cascade of water into the air.

Mobs.Name: francis drake sea dragon sir
Mobs.LongDescription: Sir Francis Drake, the Sea Dragon swims around in the water here.
Mobs.Description:
The drake looks as elegant and beautiful as any other dragon you have seen.
It whitish blue scales glitter in the sun, and its big yellow eyes looks at you
with an undying hunger.

Mobs.Name: megaladon
Mobs.LongDescription: A Megaladon, a giant shark from the deeps is hunting prey here.
Mobs.Description:
The megaladon must be a distant relative to the white shark, but four or five
times as big! As you look into its wide open mouth you see countless rows of
nine inch teeth, ready to be stained by your blood.
